title: Design contract (frontmatter of design.md)
description: A design is one device inside a topic. Its frontmatter carries the acceptance gates in machine-readable form because the iteration loop fills in the `acceptance` field of every iteration automatically; a gate written as prose cannot be regression-tested and invites a different verdict every time an agent re-reads it. The prose body carries the goal, the interpretation decisions, and the design-specific facts.

model.description: Path to the parametric model script, relative to the design directory. The IR it builds is the only supported iteration starting point: a model hand-edited in the CST GUI has no IR and therefore no topology_hash.

reference_figure.description: Figure in the source paper this design reconstructs, e.g. 'Fig. 15 / Filter D'.

ports.description: Expected port count. Checked against exported Touchstone data so a two-port export cannot be silently judged against four-port gates.

acceptance.description: Every gate is evaluated against exported curve data. A gate whose band is not covered by the data fails; it never passes vacuously.

oneOf.description: Typed curve name: s<out>_<in>_db is 20*log10(abs(S)), s<out>_<in>_deg is the unwrapped phase in degrees. Indices are underscore-separated so ports past 9 stay unambiguous.

Derived metric: a relation between two S-parameters rather than one curve. phase_shift_deg is angle(S_main) - angle(S_ref), phase_deviation_deg is its absolute distance from `target`, amplitude_imbalance_db is abs(|S_main|dB - |S_ref|dB). These exist because a multi-branch device's headline specification, such as '180 degrees plus or minus 3.4 degrees', is not a property of any single S-parameter.

main.description: [out, in] port pair of the branch under test, for a derived metric. Required for every derived metric and rejected for single-curve metrics, so a declaration is never silently ignored.

reference.description: [out, in] port pair of the branch the main branch is measured against.

phase_convention.description: Explicit product order for phase metrics. Legacy default is angle(S_main * conj(S_reference)); reference-minus-main is angle(S_reference * conj(S_main)). It does not rename physical main/reference ports.

target.description: Nominal value expected at `anchor_ghz`. Required for both phase metrics: a phase difference is only defined up to a multiple of 360 degrees, and this is what selects the branch. phase_deviation_deg additionally measures its distance from it.

anchor_ghz.description: Frequency at which `target` is expected, used to pin the 360 degree branch of a phase difference. Must lie inside the swept range; a gate whose anchor is outside it errors rather than guessing.

band_ghz.description: Inclusive [low, high] frequency window in GHz. Use the same value twice for a single-frequency gate.

mode.description: pointwise: every sample in the band, including interpolated band edges, must satisfy the comparator. aggregate: reduce the band to one number first.

aggregate.description: Required when mode is aggregate. ripple is max minus min.

severity.description: A failed 'desired' gate does not make the iteration fail overall, but is still recorded per gate.

min_samples.description: Smallest number of real (non-interpolated) samples inside the band for the verdict to be trusted. Below this the gate errors rather than passing on a curve too coarse to judge.

best.description: Pointer to the best iteration seen so far, maintained by the iteration loop.
